text:
mariana: Quick async pulse — where are we on the prefetch + continuous-batching handoff? need owners/risks before EOD.
liam: Kernel PR is green locally, fused-attn patch landed in branch `fuse/attn-v2`. still adding perf unit tests.
sam: Continuous batching flag `enable_cont_batch` toggled in canary yesterday. p50 tokens/sec improved ~12%, p99 unchanged. see dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/sprint123
anna: KV warmup change (warmup on cold load) has a regression on memory in smaller GPUs — reproducing with 8GB sim. filing a smaller fix now.
jessie: infra note: rolling kernel into Dedicated requires a driver bump; eng-infra needs 48h lead for node images. pinged @eng-infra in separate thread.
jonas: owners? who owns rollout plan + fallout playbook? we should list rollback triggers.
mariana: Owners: liam (kernel), anna (kv warmup), sam (batching + rollout), jessie (infra coord). Rollback triggers: >5% p50 regressions or >20% error-rate increase during canary.
liam: @sam can you schedule 2-hour canary window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT? I'll send PR for canary gates (traffic split + observability hooks).
sam: scheduled. canary traffic = 5% -> 25% over 30m steps. I'll add automated rollback when error-rate > 3x baseline.
ci-bot: CI: build 3821 for `fuse/attn-v2` passed (unit/integration) — e2e failing on kv-warmup test, reproducible. https://ci.redwood/3821
anna: pushing kv-warmup fix to PR, should be ready for CI retry in ~30m. small change: only warm prefixes >128 tokens for memory safety.
mariana: PR review pings: @liam please review #4723 (kernel), @anna please ping when CI is green. Also doc update: add runbook snippets under /runbooks/kernel-prefetch.md.
liam: ACK, doing review now. quick note: measuring perf across seq-lens 32/128/512 is vital — previous regressions only showed up at 512.
sam: good call. I'll add seq-len buckets to the canary dashboard and alert if any bucket drops >6% throughput.
jonas: dependency check: feature flags team, infra for image rollout, and security for KMS access (private deployments). I can pull a dependency tracker doc if helpful.
mariana: please do. also add estimated MTL (merge-to-live) timeline: kernel PR -> CI -> canary -> full roll = ~3 business days if no regressions.
liam: will open a short changelog for customers noting potential perf deltas and fallback to previous model variants.
anna: CI back to pending after fix. will report when green.
mariana: thanks all — we'll reconvene in async thread tomorrow after the canary starts. add quick notes here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
